text:
Maya: Quick sync — planning a canary for ranker-v2 today at 15:00 UTC. Plan: 2% -> 10% -> 50% over 30m steps. Who can own deploy + watch?
Liam: I can kick off the deploy and own first hour of watches. I'll be on-call pager too.
Alex: I'll be on smoke checks — short checklist: search smoke (top-10), latency p50/p95, error-rate, embeddings sanity.
Jordan: Can we limit initial cohorts to mobile-EU + desktop-USW? want geo + client mix rather than everything at once.
Sam: +1 mobile-EU + us-west desktop. Also propose adding a "small-holdout" 0.5% cohort to catch drift.
Maya: Good call. Rollback plan: feature-flag off + traffic redirect back to stable. Jordan, can you prep a one-pager with exact commands?
Jordan: Yup prepping now. Will post rollback steps and confirmation checks before 14:45 UTC.
Liam: Deploy command I'll use:
```
/deploy canary --service=ranker --image=ranker:v2-rc3 --slices=mobile-eu,desktop-usw --start-pct=2
```
Liam: Smoke checklist I'll run right after deploy:
- hit /search?q=testtop10 and validate results
- run `curl -sS https://metrics/alert?check=ranker_latency`
- confirm no 5xx in last 5m and no spike in error-rate
Alex: I'll execute the smoke and run 20 regression queries, post results here.
DeployBot: Deployment queued by Liam. ETA ~15:00 UTC. Link: https://console.redwood/ops/deploys/789
Maya: TL;DR owners: Liam (deploy), Alex (smoke), Jordan (rollback doc), Sam (cohort tagging). If everyone ok I'll approve the canary at 14:50.
Sam: Approved from infra side :thumbsup: make sure autoscaling policy is active for the slice.
Alex: Smoke looked clean at 15:08 — p50/p95 within baseline, no 5xx. I'll upload sample diffs to the regression dashboard.
Jordan: Rollback doc uploaded: https://docs.redwood/internal/rollbacks/ranker-v2.md — contains feature-flag toggle, traffic re-route command, and post-rollback validation steps.
Maya: Awesome. If anything spikes, Liam please flip the feature flag first and then run rollback. Otherwise ramp to 10% at 15:30.
Liam: Will do. I'll ping here at each ramp step and include metric snapshots. On it.
